name: TNF receptor superfamily member 1B

function.text: TNFRSF1B encodes tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 1B [Cleaved into: Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 1b, membrane form; Tumor necrosis factor-binding protein 2]. Annotated molecular activities include tumor necrosis factor receptor activity and tumor necrosis factor binding. It participates in activation of NF-kappaB-inducing kinase activity and inflammatory response.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
